desc:
Transform into 15 aliens and save your world! ⌚ One watch, endless powers: fire, speed, crystal, strength and more.

🆕 UPDATE: Dungeon difficulties from Easy to Insane, and Daily Charge rewards!

⚡ 15 ALIENS: unlock them as you level up, each with its own moves and combos.
🌍 OPEN WORLD: explore towns, forests and the lake, ride your hoverboard and find secrets.
📖 STORY: follow quests act by act and beat giant bosses.
🏰 DUNGEONS: team up with friends, survive the waves, defeat the boss and loot the chest.
🎁 DAILY CHARGE: log in every day for bigger rewards.
🎮 PLAY ANYWHERE: PC, mobile and console.

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite to get updates!
Use code: Halloween
